The HWPX safety audit brief generation succeeded with a perfect reward score, validating the document processing pipeline.

The hermes (kimi-k2.5) agent successfully completed the task with zero errors across the trial. Future iterations should maintain the current prompt structure but re-check the judge's qualitative feedback to bridge the 0.17 gap in judge_reward.
